verses.text: On the twelfth day of the tenth month, in the tenth year, the LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, turn your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

Speak to him and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, you great monster lying among your rivers. You say, "The Nile belongs to me. I made it for myself."
But I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your rivers stick to your scales. I will pull you out from among your rivers, with all the fish sticking to your scales.
I will throw you into the desert, you and all the fish of your rivers. You will fall on the open ground and will not be picked up or buried. I will give you as food to the wild animals and the birds.
Then everyone who lives in Egypt will know that I am the LORD. You have been a walking stick made of reed for the people of Israel.
When they grabbed you with their hands, you splintered and tore open their shoulders. When they leaned on you, you broke and made their backs give way.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: I will bring a sword against you and wipe out your people and your animals.
Egypt will become a desolate wasteland. Then they will know that I am the LORD. Because you said, "The Nile is mine. I made it,"
I am against you and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt a ruined and desolate wasteland, from Migdol to Aswan, as far as the border of Cush.
No human foot or animal foot will pass through it. No one will live there for forty years.

I will make Egypt the most desolate of all the ruined countries. Her cities will lie in ruins for forty years, among the ruined cities. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and spread them throughout the countries.
For this is what the Lord GOD says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered.
I will bring them back from captivity and return them to Upper Egypt, the land of their origin. There they will be a weak kingdom.
It will be the weakest of kingdoms and will never again set itself above the other nations. I will make it so weak that it will never again rule over the nations.
Egypt will never again be something the people of Israel trust in. Instead, it will remind them of their sin in turning to Egypt for help. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.'"
On the first day of the first month, in the twenty-seventh year, the LORD's message came to me:

"Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon drove his army in a hard campaign against Tyre. Every head was rubbed bare and every shoulder rubbed raw. Yet he and his army got nothing from Tyre for all the work they did against it.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: 'I am going to give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will carry off its wealth. He will loot and plunder it as pay for his army.
I have given him Egypt as payment for his work, because his army did it for me, says the Lord GOD.'
On that day I will make the people of Israel strong again, and I will open your mouth to speak among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD."
